sites.name: Corporate headquarters
sites.description: Corporate headquarters in Santa Clara, California, about 941,000 square feet leased.

source.label: Palo Alto Networks Form 10-K for fiscal 2024 (year ended July 31, 2024), Item 2. Properties
source.quote: Our corporate headquarters is located in Santa Clara, California, where we lease approximately 941,000 square feet of space under three lease agreements that expire in July 2028

notes: Palo Alto Networks publishes no state or country impact report that was found. The FY2024 10-K gives a global workforce of 15,289 with no geographic split; Item 2 names the leased Santa Clara HQ (~941,000 sq ft, plus 10.4 owned acres next to it), leased space "around the world, including Israel and India", and co-located data centers in the United States, Europe and Asia, with no figures. The only geographic footprint figures are long-lived assets (PP&E plus operating lease ROU assets) for the U.S., Israel and other countries.
